_meta.status: PROVISIONAL: every number is chosen for what a player feels and is a first proposal to play; nothing is fitted to a percentage, a line or a ceiling. Shared numbers are references to scale.json and pacing.json.
_meta.rulings: 00-rulings.md A to F (F wins): A4, A5, A7, A8, B13, C16 to C20, F29 to F32, F34
_meta.shape: tools/balance/bible/SCHEMA.md section 3; one extension: a cash-out may carry named numbers of its own (most_foes, bite_less) read by its formula as references, and an alternative reading of the same move (reading_of) so the checker prints it

slam.name: Slam (one foe beside you)
slam.formula: 1 + plate(L, A, S, G) * bite * cash(n) / plain
slam.why: Ruling 34: a plain shield blow plus the plates' weight (one plate's soak, read before Pain Threshold's feed, x Bite x the cash-out sum); no roll, no Margins. The wall that stood and took it hits back with everything it stood for.

slam_ring.name: Slam (the foes beside you)
slam_ring.formula: min(@body.attributes.endurance.door.cashouts.slam_ring.most_foes, 1 + floor(cash(n))) + plate(L, A, S, G) * bite * cash(n) / plain
slam_ring.per_hit: 1 + plate(L, A, S, G) * bite * cash(n) / plain
slam_ring.why: Ruling 45: the ring strikes as many foes beside you as Cleave's rule gives for the plates spent (1 + S(n) rounded down: one plate strikes 2, three plates 4, five or more every foe beside you), each a plain blow and the shove; the plates' weight lands on the one you face. The other foes beside you take the shove only. Ruling 40: capped a hit (the faced foe's), the total printed; the floor counts the total (a spread cash-out).

worth.unit: the character's own plain attacks: shield blows
worth.formula: 1 + plate x bite x S(n) / plain (plate / plain = 0.1116: one plate soak over the ram plate blow, both on the deal column with the same pair, so the share is the same at every level)
worth.ruling: I table; ruling 60 (Guard keeps its quick fill; the base door's Slam stays modest; its reward is the soak)
worth.shape: falling: a unit is worth less as Reach grows, so Bite is set on the worth curve 2.000 x (3.000 / 2.000)^((p - 1) / 9) at every point where Reach or Bite steps (1, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10): the full cash-out climbs at every point; a part-filled one is worth a little less after a Reach step (for the lead)

push.name: Overbrace
push.price: a share of your max HP at the start of your next turn when the extra plate was spent (nothing soaks it)
push.why: Ruling 45: a tenth of your own bar (Overbind's shape, soul.json insight door.push; scale.costs.rules.share), not Bleeding, which did not stack, lasted 3 rounds, ended with a stim and cost about 6 of a 414 bar at level 5 (critic-player-3 2): the plate past your last is your own body, and the wall feels it every time.
